title: Non-Existence of Linear-Quartic Factorization for the Second Cuboid Quintic
summary: Let $Q_{p,q}(t)\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ be Sharipov's even monic degree-$10$ second cuboid polynomial depending on coprime integers $p\neq q>0$. Writing $Q_{p,q}(t)$ as a quintic in $t^{2}$ produces an associated monic quintic polynomial. After the weighted normalization $r=p/q$ and $s=r^{2}$ we obtain a one-parameter family $P_s(x)\in\mathbb{Q}[x]$ such that \[ Q_{p,q}(t)=q^{20}\,P_s\!\left(\frac{t^{2}}{q^{4}}\right)\qquad\text{with}\qquad s=\left(\frac{p}{q}\right)^{2}. \] We show that for every rational $s>0$ with $s\neq 1$ the equation $P_s(x)=0$ has no rational solutions.
